## Load in Packages

```{r}
# load in necessary packages
library("tidyverse")
library("brms")
library("ggeffects")
library("readxl")
```

## Read in Data

```{r}
# read in the data from the excel file
Poll_Data <- read_xlsx("Ellie_ChiSquare.xlsx", sheet = 1)

head(Poll_Data)


```

## Flower Shape Dataframes

```{r}
# Create new dataframe 
Fl_Shape <- Poll_Data %>% 
  # used the select function to keep only 3 columns
  select(PollinatorOrder, PollinatorFamily, PollGenusSpeciesUSE, FlowerShape) %>% 
  # Get rid of flowers with unknown shape
  filter(FlowerShape != "U")


# create new dataframe for just bees
Fl_ShapeSp <- Fl_Shape %>% 
  # use mutate to create new column to separate honey bees from wild bees
  mutate(BeeType = ifelse(Fl_Shape$PollGenusSpeciesUSE == "Apis mellifera",
    "Honey Bee", 
    "Wild Bee")) %>% 
  # Filter dataframe to just include hymenoptera and get rid of non-bees
  filter(PollinatorOrder == "Hymenoptera", PollinatorFamily != "Agridae")
  )

# check it filtered the families correctly
print(unique(Fl_ShapeSp$PollinatorFamily))
```

### Exploratory Graphs

```{r}
# Exploratory Graph based on Order and FLower Shape
ggplot(Fl_Shape, aes(PollinatorOrder, fill = FlowerShape)) +
  # make a stacked bar plot to see differences in percent visitation frequency among orders
  geom_bar(position = "fill")
```

```{r}
# Exploratory Graph based on Bee Type and FLower Shape
ggplot(Fl_ShapeSp, aes(BeeType, fill = FlowerShape)) +
  # make a stacked bar plot to see differences in percent visitation frequency among orders
  geom_bar(position = "fill")
```

### Contingency Tables

```{r}
# Create contingency table for shape and pollinator order for easier analysis
ShapeOrder <- table(
  Fl_Shape$FlowerShape, Fl_Shape$PollinatorOrder)
# print to make sure it works
print(ShapeOrder)
```

```{r}
# Create contingency table for shape and Bee Type for easier analysis
ShapeBee <- table(
  Fl_ShapeSp$FlowerShape, Fl_ShapeSp$BeeType)
# print to make sure it works
print(ShapeBee)

b <- chisq.test(ShapeOrder)
print(b)
```
